source: ios-server/devtools/build_event_exchanges.py. Event exchanges (King Mog and similar) sold in the Shop by exvius_shop_catalogue.py from the client's own F_MEDAL_EXCHANGE_MST rows (store F_STORE_ITEM_MST type 50). Shown while one of event_areas is in this week's Vortex, or while the player holds the currency (then the latest exchange for that currency whose event has run). `rows` is the stock of the event's own run (see period_stock); `farm` sizes the currency event_currency.py pays per clear. `summon_screen`: summon-screen exchanges whose currency these events pay (their schedule opens them in those events' weeks).

farm.held: Orbonne Monastery Vaults: Auracite Shards drop from the Vaults' enemies instead, sized by the 30-run rule (build_global_drops.SIZED_CURRENCY); never a per-clear lump (operator, 2026-11-10)
